chunks: What Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah narrated from Ahmad and 'Abd Allah, the two sons of Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: Should the female slave cover her head? He said: No, and it is not upon Umm al-Walad to cover her head if she does not have a child.

key_terms.أُمِّ الْوَلَدِ: a slave woman who has borne a child for her master

ai.seo_question: Does a female slave or Umm al-Walad have to cover her head in salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning head covering in salat for a female slave and for Umm al-Walad. It indicates that, unlike a free woman, they are not required to cover the head in the case described here.
